_comment: The pixel font, forced past any other font mod.
This used to reference minecraft:include/default - but that is exactly
what a font mod like Caxton overrides, so 'Minecraft' picked up
Caxton's typeface instead of the real one. Pointing at our own copy of
the pixel glyphs guarantees the game's original look no matter what
Only the Latin block is copied. Accented and non-Latin characters still
come through the vanilla references below, which is fine: a font mod
replaces the Latin glyphs, and those are what 'Minecraft' has to win
